notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
In celebration of the 1st anniversary since release, the circus has hit town! Well, more precisely Sharling Castle, where you can now enjoy a show and earn a bit of extra experience. Don't worry it's free!


This will probably be the last update, as work is now all directed towards Operation Terra (see below)
It was a fun ride, glad to see the majority enjoyed the game at least to some degree. 
Thanks to all who showed their support, financially or otherwise!

notes.title: Patch 1.82
notes.notes:
Patch 1.82

Fixed a bug with one of the new achievements not showing up from a saved game.
Fixed a bug that had crept up not showing the right character name after swapping.
Changed "Mad As A Hatter"'s objective to "Clear the sewers on permadeath using only Maddie from the start" to keep it challenging but make it less time consuming. If anyone has already started trying to achieve it the other/old way, they can keep at it, it will also still work.

notes.title: Update 1.8: Fossils + Museum
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647287/f8258b917722a4b22bda06509c2807a75d4afd38.jpg

Fossils and the museum:
End of level enemies now leave fossils; in the first 20 locations only one, then increasing to a random number between 1 and 3 by the end game. End game bossed can leave up to 4. Fossils can be sold in the museum in the starting city of Nepros and are worth 120% of a typical round of begging (and without the sneering). The real good thing about fossils is that you can let them pile up and then sell them all together, so, say you have put aside 10 through a few locations, you can hit the museum and with one single activity round it will be like doing begging 12 times (and again without the sneering). Good for a cash injection when you are close to what you need for that next piece of gear.

Other changes/fixes:
Kugraltha's life and attack increased by about 10 %.
Value of treasure found when mining increased by 15 %.
"next" button in stats screen changed to "more" and "back".
Moved the "check out the shops" part of the tutorial to the end of the arena just when meeting the end boss, as that's the optimal moment to upgrade.
Fixed a bug in the altar screen where the character icon showing wasn't the right one.
Fixed a bug where the question mark of undiscovered characters would appear on top of the enlarged version of available characters and of the swap note, partially covering the text.
Fixed a bug where it was possible to have negative experience to gain for the next level due to obtaining "extatic" meditation while having optimal bonuses.

notes.title: Patch 1.74
notes.notes:
Adds four specific resolutions options taken directly from what the monitor lists as its possible resolutions, for those cases where the default isn't quite working appropriately.
Also adds a "Force 1600 x 900" as kind of a last resort.

notes.title: Update 1.73.
notes.notes:
Balance fixes:
+ 2% overall side activities gains.
- 5% to farming gains.
- 10% to meditation average gains (and losses).

Slightly eases up the beginning for those who have problems with it:

- 2 hp to first 3 end of level enemies ("bosses").
+ 1 gold to begging at any level.
+ 3 gold for defeating any enemy in the arena; + 2 gold for defeating any enemy in the sewers entrance; + 1 gold for defeating any enemy in the sewers.

Added "Read the tips for further strategy advice" to tutorial.

notes.title: Launch Date + Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647287/d29fec0d5fa1413f29d1efa5ca2b1de5f7025af9.jpg

Wicked Times will transition to Full Release on the 12th of January. The last planned update (new character Xan) will also be released on the 12th. It will have a 10% launch discount, so if you were planning on purchasing over the next few days, you might want to hold off.
Also, a demo is coming over the next few days.
Future plans: I will still add a few features and update the game, just not as often as it's been happening in Early Access.

notes.title: Patch 1.52
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with "Continue" sometimes disappearing in normal difficulty and sometimes appearing after dying in permadeath.
Fixed an issue when restarting multiple times on permadeath.

notes.title: Release 1.5! Permadeath!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to risk it all? to avoid dying at all costs? then permadeath is for you. In Permanent Death dying means losing all your progress and being engulfed by darkness for good... so don't!

Other changes:

General + 5% gains for all side activities.
You now have to go throught the tutorial the first time you play; you can only skip on subsequent playthroughs. (Too many people were skipping and getting confused.)
Beatrix substitutes Maddie/Hatter(character 6) with the same ability. Maddie is going to come back later with different abilities.
Fixed bug when starting a new game with an unlocked character.
Added seagulls background sound when fishing.
Added sound when drinking potions.

+ other minor fixes
